applies_to: Advantage Controls MegaTron water treatment controllers (cooling tower and boiler water chemistry) with the BACnet H21 or H25 (dual network card, MegaTron MT only) option, software JA.12.1 and higher.
summary: With the H21 or H25 option the MegaTron is a read-only BACnet IP device. It reports conductivity, pH, ORP, temperatures, water meter and flow meter values and up to sixteen 4-20 mA / 0-5 V inputs for up to four systems, plus alarm flags, setpoints, timer run times and relay states. Every object in this manual is marked Read Only, so the BMS can monitor but not adjust the controller.
notes: Object names in the manual are generic (BI-000, BV-011, AI-008 ...); the Purpose column is used as the description.
Every object, including the setpoint AVs and relay state MSVs, is marked Read Only. The H22 manual marks the same AVs and MSVs Read / Write.

Compared with H22, this list adds mA inputs 9-16 (AI 64-71) and their alarms (BV 360-391), drops the 'Future Use' BVs, BV 300 Utility, BV 301 All Alarms, the M. Conductivity alarms and the mA input 'Alarm' flags, and labels AI 45-53 as flow meter contact values instead of totals.
Instances start at 0 and most points repeat for System #1 to #4. No engineering units are printed.
BV 316 is printed with the object name BV-216 (kept as printed); BV 348 is printed as Bv-348.
Relay state MSVs use the printed states 1=H-OFF, 2=H-ON, 3=OFF, 4=ON.

source.title: MegaTron Controller Supplemental BACnet H21 / H25 Communications Manual

integration.summary: Monitoring only. Read the chemistry inputs (conductivity, pH, ORP) and the flow switch for each system in use, and the per-system alarm BVs you need (there is no summary alarm object in this list). All objects are read-only, so setpoints and relays are changed at the controller, not from the BMS.
setup: BACnet IP only (Annex J), on the same Ethernet port used for the WebAdvantage service.
Set the device instance and UDP port (47808 shown) in Setup/Run > Configure > Network > Settings > BAC, then reset the communications card and cycle power.
On H25 (dual network card, MegaTron MT only) the dual network card must be enabled before the BAC options appear.
4194303 means unconfigured; the BMS must be on the same subnet as the MegaTron or BACnet traffic must be routed.
Protocol revision 24, B-ASC; only DS-RP-B is listed for data sharing, so read one property per request.
gotchas: There is no All Alarms summary object (H22 has BV 301); map individual alarm BVs.
No writable objects: setpoints, alarm limits and relays cannot be changed from the BMS on H21/H25.
Points exist for four systems and sixteen mA inputs whether or not they are installed.
AI 45-53 are flow meter contact values here, not totals as on H22.

note: Provided as-is. Point availability varies by firmware and options; verify against the live device.
